serviceName: Basecomp website on your root domain (Cloudflare DNS)
description: Points the root of your domain at your Basecomp website and proves you own it, so a free SSL certificate can be issued. For Cloudflare DNS only: Cloudflare flattens a CNAME at the root and does not support APEXCNAME. Basecomp requests this service only when discovery returns Cloudflare, without host. hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it (DCTL1012); Cloudflare ignores it.
variableDescription: %ownership%: the hostname ownership token Cloudflare for SaaS issues for this domain (a UUID)
